advancements.rotp_nextalbum.get_aja_ston: Obtain a Super Aja Stone in any form.
item.rotp_nextalbum.luck_pluck.reference: "Jonathan... I offer you the word engraved on my sword! Luck! And take this with you to your future! Pluck! "
item.nextalbum.luck_pluck.tooltips: Has same enchantment capabilities with a golden sword and a longer attack range. Additionally, you can use the Hamon action, which can only be used unarmed, while holding this item.
item.rotp_nextalbum.aja_stone_necklace.r: "This is it... Nature's perfect miracle crystal. Without a single imperfection! The Super Aja!"
item.nextalbum.aja_stone_necklace.toolti: When equipped, this allows you to press %s+%s to unleash a beam attack with effects, damage, and cooldowns identical to the Super Aja item.
item.nextalbum.mista_suit.tooltips: Each suit piece provides +15% protection against projectile and bullet damage.
item.nextalbum.suit.effect.narrow_escape: Each piece grants 15% projectile resistance. With the full set, being hit by a projectile raises Resolve.
item.nextalbum.suit.effect.speedloader.d: While wearing this piece, one revolver reload fills every empty chamber at once.
item.nextalbum.suit.effect.bullet_storag: Store up to 256 revolver rounds (right-click ammo onto it in the inventory; right-click it with an empty cursor to take them out). The revolver draws from it when reloading.
item.nextalbum.spirit_cigarette.tooltip: Right-click to light. Hold right-click to inhale, then release to exhale smoke and gain Focus.
Shift + right-click to hold up to five lit cigarettes in your mouth. They grant Focus passively and vanish when burned out.
advancements.rotp_nextalbum.jotaro_trick: Do that special trick again, Jotaro!
Hold five cigarettes in your mouth at once.
advancements.rotp_nextalbum.smoked_the_w: The Man Who Smoked the World
Smoke an entire cigarette in a single inhale.
item.rotp_nextalbum.prosciutto_suit_clot: "There's no such thing as 'kill him' in our world. That's what cowards say."
item.rotp_nextalbum.prosciutto_suit_pant: "There's no such thing as 'kill him' in our world. That's what cowards say."
item.rotp_nextalbum.prosciutto_suit_boot: "There's no such thing as 'kill him' in our world. That's what cowards say."
item.nextalbum.suit.effect.assassination: With the full set, right-click to cycle appearances. Stealth mode can turn you into a shadow player after 10 seconds out of combat, or immediately if you age yourself or enter darkness. Combat only drops the shadow skin (the suit still shows as the default look) and does not leave Stealth. Shadow players hide their name, shrink hostile aggro, and make already-locked hostiles and neutrals lose their target.
item.nextalbum.suit.effect.glorious_deat: With the full set, Resolve delayed-death lasts longer.
item.nextalbum.suit.effect.mammoni_resol: With the full set, Stand stats drop to 80%. As Resolve rises they scale linearly up to 150% of the original.
item.nextalbum.suit.effect.inherited_wil: With the full set, being near a player in Resolve delayed-death rapidly raises your Resolve and triggers Resolve. While that player is still downed, your Resolve drains at half speed.
rotp_nextalbum.options.onomatopoeiaParti: Show onomatopoeia particles in certain situations. Only visible to Stand users.
rotp_nextalbum.options.resolveAura.toolt: Show Resolve aura particles on the player and Stand while Resolve is active.
rotp_nextalbum.options.resolveAuraForAll: If enabled, Resolve aura applies to all Stands. If disabled, only this addon's Stands are affected.
rotp_nextalbum.options.resolveAuraOnSumm: Show Resolve aura as soon as a Stand is summoned, even without the Resolve effect.
rotp_nextalbum.configuration.title: NextAlbum
advancements.rotp_nextalbum.full_pesci_s: The Angler Who Inherited a Will
rotp_nextalbum.options.lastActionForAllS: When enabled, any Stand user with Resolve level above 0 can trigger delayed death. Skills stay usable and the timer drains quickly with stamina.
jojo.message.action_condition.resolve_do: While downed you can only keep the aging mist going
message.rotp_nextalbum.resolve_downed.gi: Hold Shift + Jump for 3 seconds to give up
advancements.rotp_nextalbum.glorious_dea: Keep The Grateful Dead's aging mist active for a full minute while downed in Resolve, then die.
advancements.rotp_nextalbum.last_words.d: Keep using Stand skills while delayed-dying, and die because of it.
